title: Hall band personnel and pianist Bennett Turner
summary: Howard lists the six-piece band's members and says Turner was a good music-reading pianist.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Orchestrations? No, no. For everybody. How many players do they have? About five or six in the band? Six of them. Six. At the
La Vida was Jim, Paul Barnes, Sidney Fleischer on guitar. Robert Davis on drums and Bennett Turner on piano which is a real good musician.
What happened to Turner? Is he still around? Does he play? I haven't heard of him.
Well I haven't seen him in a long time but he's a good musician. Well he's the one to go
by the music. Go by the music. You're the guy Louie on Lutzenz. Did you ever play Lutzenz?
